description: This file defines the PrepareBodyMiddleware class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for preparing HTTP request objects by adding necessary headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect. It manages request modifications based on the request's body size and properties, and determines if additional headers need to be set before sending the request.

classes.name: PrepareBodyMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class responsible for preparing HTTP requests with appropriate headers like Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect before they are sent.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a next handler callable to process the request.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the request, adds necessary headers based on the request body and options, and invokes the next handler.

methods.name: addExpectHeader
methods.description: Private method to determine whether to add the Expect header and modify the request accordingly.
